note: The directory page returned 403 to our fetch. A directory listing seen in search says the store is on South 4th Street in Queen Village and holds Magic and Pokemon events and community nights. Own website not found.

name: Delco Scrabble Club
note: Feb 2026 Inquirer feature says the club meets weekly at Riddle Village in Media, Delaware County. No website, set day or contact found in the article. Outside the city; a just-outside candidate if it welcomes visitors.

name: Pinball Gallery (Malvern) and Railroad Street Bar and Grill (Linfield) pinball leagues
note: Named in an April 2023 guide, not fetched. Both venues are outside Philadelphia and the dates are old. Pinball Gallery's Ball Busters is a women's league.

name: Orianna Hill Dog Park (Friends of Orianna Hill Park)
note: Named on Philadelphia magazine's dog park list as a members-only park at 900 North Orianna Street. The site returned empty text on two fetches, so it needs a re-check. The friends group's name is not verified.

name: Queen Village K9 (Mario Lanza Dog Run)
note: The magazine's list names QVK9 as the association for the Mario Lanza Dog Run. The qvk9.org address redirects to unrelated domains, so it was not used. Needs another source.

name: Schuylkill River Park Dog Run friends group
note: The magazine links this dog run to a domain that now redirects to an unrelated site. The friends group that maintains the run was not identified.
